title: 第1611章 和平方案第1610章 小仙珠
content_zh:
二狗子修炼出关，第一时间就查看了这段时间，墨羽传回的消息。
在他闭关的这一年多里，两大仙君府彻底杀红了眼。
战斗没有停过，甚至愈演愈烈，战斗规模更大了，双方不断地往混乱之地增派人手。
据墨羽统计，双方战死的合体期高手，已经有八十多人。
如今整个混乱之地的合体期高手，一共也只有八九十人。
根据最近传回来的一份情报，双方大乘期老祖也被惊动出关了。
一般这个级别的修仙者，平时都在筹备渡劫成仙事宜，极少露面。
每耽误一天时间，就等于减少一分渡劫存活的概率。
大乘期强者出面，应该不想耽误太多的时间，这场争斗，大概快要结束了。
二狗子刚看完这些情报信息，腰间储物袋中，发出轻微的振动。
轻轻一拍储物袋，从里面飞出一面铜镜，漂浮在面前。
铜镜中散发出白蒙蒙的光芒，里面显露出墨羽的身影。
“岛主，刚刚得到情报，两大仙君府的大乘期强者会面了。”
铜镜中墨羽的身影清晰，声音也能听得很清楚，和面对面交流几乎没什么差别。
事实上，墨羽此刻正身处几十万里之外。
“两个大乘期强者碰面了，没有当场打起来吗？”
二狗子有些幸灾乐祸地问道。
如果两边的大乘强者打起来，那就有好戏看了。
不过，他转念一想，很快就高兴不起来了。
大乘期的神通威能那么强，可不是合体期能比的。

到时候，混乱之地的修士被战火波及，恐怕损失会更大。
虽然现在有周天万界传讯阵，但以大乘期战斗的速度和波及的范围，逃跑都来不及。
好在，镜子里的墨羽摇了摇头。
“没有！”
“根据现有情报推测，两位大乘期强者应该没打算出手，可能会和谈。”
二狗子心中也跟着松了一口气。
心中希望这两家能谈和成功，不要再打了，再打下去，混乱之地真的受不了。
“知道他们谈的大概内容吗？”
“目前还不知道。”
墨羽摇了摇头，大乘期这种强者，普通人都没资格接近，更别想套到他们的情报。
“不知道也没事，小心打探，安全第一。”
二狗子又嘱咐两句，大乘期强者谈和的具体内容，对于混乱之地来说，好像没那么重要。
只要两大仙君府结束能战斗，让混乱之地重归于平静，就是好事……
…………
在一片海域的云端上，两名老者相对而坐。
在他们之间摆了一方小桌，桌上有棋盘，有仙果，仙茶，仙酿美酒……
这两人，就是两大仙君府的大乘期强者，此刻并没有如同大家所想象中的剑拔弩张。
反而相对而坐，喝着酒，下着棋，谈笑风生。
“风泽道友，你我得有七八百年没见过面了吧？”
身穿褐袍的老者，喝了一口酒，看着下方平静的海面，若有所思。

“是呀，自从上次万妖大会与袁正道友一别，你我都忙着闭关，哪有时间顾及这些琐事。”
另一名背生双翅的青袍中年，看着远方云卷云舒，若有所忆。
content_en:
After Ergouzi came out of seclusion, he immediately checked the news sent back by Mo Yu during this period.
During the more than a year that he was in seclusion, the two Immortal Lords' Mansion were completely jealous.
The battle never stopped, and even intensified. The scale of the battle became larger, and both sides continued to send more men to the chaotic place.
According to Mo Yu's statistics, more than 80 masters of the combined stage died in the battle on both sides.
Nowadays, there are only eighty or ninety masters in the integration stage in the entire chaotic land.
According to a piece of information recently passed back, the Mahayana ancestors of both sides were also alarmed and left seclusion.
Generally, immortal cultivators of this level are usually preparing for the matter of overcoming tribulations and becoming immortals, and rarely show up.
Every day of delay is equivalent to reducing the probability of surviving through the tribulation by one point.
The strong men of the Mahayana stage come forward, and they probably don't want to waste too much time. This battle is probably almost over.
Ergouzi had just finished reading the intelligence information when a slight vibration came from the storage bag on his waist.
With a tap on the storage bag, a bronze mirror flew out from inside and floated in front of you.
White light emitted from the bronze mirror, and Mo Yu's figure was revealed inside.
"Island Master, we have just received information that two Mahayana-stage powerhouses from the Immortal Lord's Mansion have met."
Mo Yu's figure in the bronze mirror was clear and his voice could be heard clearly. It was almost the same as face-to-face communication.
In fact, Mo Yu was hundreds of thousands of miles away at the moment.
"Two powerful men in the Mahayana stage met. Didn't they start fighting on the spot?"
Ergouzi asked with some gloating.
If the powerful Mahayana men on both sides fight, it will be a good show.
However, when he thought about it, he soon became unhappy.
The magical powers in the Mahayana stage are so powerful that they cannot be compared to those in the combined stage.
By then, the monks in the Chaos Land will be affected by the flames of war, and their losses will probably be even greater.
Although there is now a Zhoutian Ten Thousand Realms Communication Formation, with the speed and scope of the Mahayana battle, it is too late to escape.
Fortunately, Mo Yu in the mirror shook his head.
"No!"
"Based on the available intelligence, it is speculated that the two powerful men in the Mahayana stage have no intention of taking action and may negotiate for peace."
Er Gouzi also breathed a sigh of relief.
I hope in my heart that these two families can successfully negotiate a peace and stop fighting. If the fighting continues, the chaotic land will really not be able to bear it.
"Do you know the general content of what they talked about?"
"We don't know yet."
Mo Yu shook his head. Ordinary people were not qualified to approach powerful people like Mahayana, let alone get their information.
"It's okay if you don't know. Be careful when you inquire. Safety first."
Ergouzi gave a few more instructions. The specific content of the peace talks between the powerful men in the Mahayana period did not seem to be that important to the chaotic land.
As long as the two Immortal Sovereigns are finished and can fight, it will be a good thing for the chaotic land to return to peace...
…………
On the clouds in a sea area, two old men sat opposite each other.
A small table was placed between them. There was a chessboard on the table, fairy fruits, fairy tea, fairy wine...
These two people are the Mahayana stage powerhouses of the two Immortal Lord Mansion. At this moment, there is no tense situation as everyone imagined.
Instead, they sat opposite each other, drinking wine, playing chess, talking and laughing.
"Fellow Daoist Fengze, you and I have not seen each other for seven or eight hundred years, right?"
The old man in brown robe took a sip of wine and looked at the calm sea below, thoughtfully.
"Yes, since we said goodbye to fellow Taoist Yuan Zheng at the last Ten Thousand Demons Conference, you and I have been busy retreating and have no time to take care of these trivial matters."
Another middle-aged man in a green robe with wings on his back looked at the clouds rolling in the distance, as if he was remembering something.
